facts.text: The Spartan Tuition Advantage covers full tuition for incoming first-years who qualify for in-state tuition, are Pell-eligible and have household income of $75,000 or less. You just apply for admission and file the FAFSA.
Michigan State has a two-year live-on requirement for students who start there as first-years.
